tasks.title: Backdate LastModified instead of sleeping, then pluralise the entity test folders and namespaces
acceptance: Task.Delay removal (backlog row 2026-09-17-core-type-identity, Gate 2 D1 of 20261118-0114-backlog-triage). Do this half before the rename. `grep -rn --exclude-dir=bin --exclude-dir=obj Task.Delay C:/dm-wt/20261118-2110-decided-test-rows/src/DungeonMaster.Tests` prints nothing. At f2aead0 it prints exactly 2 lines, `Domain/Entities/EntityEqualityTests.cs:175` and `Domain/Entities/Floor/FloorMethodsTests.cs:18`, both `await Task.Delay(20);`. Must-match control in the changed tree: `grep -rn --exclude-dir=bin --exclude-dir=obj -e Task.Delay -e 'void ForceId' C:/dm-wt/20261118-2110-decided-test-rows/src/DungeonMaster.Tests` prints the `ForceId` declaration line (`EntityEqualityTests.cs:192` at f2aead0) and no `Task.Delay` line.

Backdating mechanism (the remedy D1 fixed, encoded with test discipline 'Isolation: No test depends on the wall clock' and 'Determinism: No sleeping'). `GetHashCode_AfterAMutationThatTouchesLastModified_IsUnchanged` (EntityEqualityTests.cs) and `UpdateNumber_WhenCalled_UpdatesLastModified` (FloorMethodsTests.cs) keep their names, are no longer `async`, and each one, in its Arrange step, sets `LastModified` on the entity it later asserts on through reflection on `Entity`'s private setter, `typeof(Entity).GetProperty(nameof(Entity.LastModified))`, the mechanism `ForceId` uses for `Id` (EntityEqualityTests.cs:192-195 at f2aead0). The instant set is a fixed literal, not derived from `DateTime.Now` or `DateTime.UtcNow`, and each test still asserts that `LastModified` is after the value captured before the Act step. The helper lives as a private static method in each file that uses it (ForceId precedent). Evidence: `grep -rn 'nameof(Entity.LastModified)' C:/dm-wt/20261118-2110-decided-test-rows/src/DungeonMaster.Tests/Domain/Entities` prints at least one line in each of the two files (nothing at f2aead0; control `grep -rn 'nameof(Entity.Id)' C:/dm-wt/20261118-2110-decided-test-rows/src/DungeonMaster.Tests/Domain/Entities` prints `EntityEqualityTests.cs:194` at f2aead0). No production clock seam is added (orchestrator row: no production file changes).

Each of the two tests fails when LastModified is not updated, shown by demonstrated discrimination with the tests fixed and the production code varied (lesson 2026-09-16 discrimination by varying input). Run once, against the task's final test files after the rename, one injection live at a time: (a) copy C:/dm-wt/20261118-2110-decided-test-rows/src/DungeonMaster.Domain/Entities/Entity.cs aside; (b) at Entity.cs:33, the body of `Touch` and the only line whose text after its two leading tabs is `LastModified = DateTime.UtcNow;`, replace that text with `_ = DateTime.UtcNow;`. The architect compiled exactly this injection at f2aead0 on a byte-identical scratch copy of the five projects DungeonMaster.Tests builds: 0 Warning(s), 0 Error(s). The self-assignment `LastModified = LastModified;` does not compile here (CA2245 as an error) and is not to be used; (c) run `dotnet build C:/dm-wt/20261118-2110-decided-test-rows/src/DungeonMaster.Tests/DungeonMaster.Tests.csproj` and then `dotnet test C:/dm-wt/20261118-2110-decided-test-rows/src/DungeonMaster.Tests/DungeonMaster.Tests.csproj --no-build --filter "FullyQualifiedName~EntityEqualityTests.GetHashCode_AfterAMutationThatTouchesLastModified_IsUnchanged|FullyQualifiedName~FloorMethodsTests.UpdateNumber_WhenCalled_UpdatesLastModified"`, which must report `Failed: 2, Passed: 0` and `Total: 2`, each failure being the `LastModified` `BeAfter` assertion (the architect's scratch run of this injection printed `Expected ...LastModified to be after <2000-01-01>, but found <2000-01-01>` for both, with a 2000-01-01 backdate); (d) restore the copy and confirm the sha256 of Entity.cs is the f2aead0 value given in the next criterion before any other command runs; (e) rebuild and re-run the same filter: `Failed: 0, Passed: 2, Total: 2`. The filter selects exactly these 2 tests (architect scratch run with the remedy applied: Total: 2). The report names the injection site, quotes the injected line as read back, the summary lines of (c) and (e), and the revert hash, so the window is visible to the reviewer.

tasks.title: Widen ThemeHygieneTests to report bare FontSize and FontFamily Setters, with a synthetic control
acceptance: The widened probe (backlog row 2026-09-02-app-sub-suite-rebuild on the Setter-form hole, Gate 2 D8 of 20261118-0114-backlog-triage). A `<Setter>` element in a scanned document, meaning outside `Resources/Theme` (`ScannedXamlDocuments`, ThemeHygieneTests.cs:282-296 at f2aead0), is reported as an offender when its `Property` attribute names `FontSize` or `FontFamily` after any `Type.` prefix (the comparison `IsProperty` makes for attribute names, :448-461) and its `Value` attribute is bare by `IsBareFontSize` or `IsBareFontFamily` (:463-473). `NoBareFontSizesOutsideTheThemeDictionaries` reports a FontSize Setter and `NoBareFontFamiliesOutsideTheThemeDictionaries` reports a FontFamily Setter, each with the file, the line and the offending text, as the attribute form does (:378-379). The change is made in ThemeHygieneTests.cs alone; ThemeSource.cs belongs to T2.

Positive control: a new test feeds a synthetic in-memory XAML document containing `<Setter Property="FontSize" Value="14" />` and `<Setter Property="FontFamily" Value="EBGaramondRegular" />` through the same probe method the two facts above call, not through a copy of it, and asserts that each Setter is reported. The shared method encodes test discipline 'A test that would still pass with the implementation deleted is not a test': a control that called a copy would stay green with the facts' widening deleted.

Negative control, which must not fire: the same probe, given `<Setter Property="FontSize" Value="{StaticResource DmFontSizeBody}" />` and `<Setter Property="IconFontSize" Value="16" />`, reports nothing.

The positive control is shown able to fail. Inject one defect into the Setter branch alone, at one named file:line in ThemeHygieneTests.cs, that stops a FontSize or FontFamily Setter from being recognised while the attribute form still works. Then run `dotnet build C:/dm-wt/20261118-2110-decided-test-rows/src/DungeonMaster.Tests/DungeonMaster.Tests.csproj` and `dotnet test C:/dm-wt/20261118-2110-decided-test-rows/src/DungeonMaster.Tests/DungeonMaster.Tests.csproj --no-build` with a `--filter` that names the control, which must fail. Revert, read the site back against a copy taken before injecting, and re-run the same filter, which must pass. The report quotes the injected text, the filter, both summary lines and the read-back, and states the population the filter selected as the run lists it (lesson 2026-09-18 test-filter population).

The allow-list self-check stays consistent: `StillOffends(ThemeDocument)` (ThemeHygieneTests.cs:259-275 at f2aead0) recognises the Setter form through the same predicate, so a `PendingMigration` entry whose only offence is a bare Setter is not reported stale by `EveryAllowListedFileExistsAndStillOffends`.

Doc comments the widening falsifies are corrected in the same change, at least the `XamlAttributeOffenders` summary (ThemeHygieneTests.cs:347-353 at f2aead0), which says `an attribute NAMED FontSize is the only thing that matches`, and any class or member remark in the file that describes the probe as attribute-only. Every sentence this task writes or rewrites in a `///` comment in ThemeHygieneTests.cs follows dotnet-format.md section 9 (the project convention the dispatch names): its `///` line is indented with two tabs after the marker, it is a complete sentence ending with a period, and it is not broken across `///` lines.
